newsitem.title: USA: Modern Medical working on merger plan.
newsitem.headline: Modern Medical working on merger plan.

text.p: Modern Medical Modalities Corp said Monday its board has directed officers of the company to work out terms and structure of a potential merger plan within 60 days with RF Management Corp.
The company said the directors issued the directive "so the plan can be approved by the board of directors and submitted for shareholder approval."

John Goldberg, treasurer of Modern Medical, an operator of diagnostic imaging centers, said in a telephone interview his company took the move to look into the possibility of a merger with RF Management.
He said RF Management, which is also based in Morristown, operates outpatient surgery centers, has mobile magnetic resonance imaging units and also has diagnostic imaging centers.
"We have no preconceived notion on how this could be done or if could be done at all," he said.
Modern Medical's management is now looking into whether there is any pontential transaction and "if this makes sense," he added.
